tldr: Anthropic locks in a ~$35B Nvidia-backed Lambda deal (~350MW, Texas) — roughly $80B compute committed in days ahead of a reported fall IPO push; Moonshot confidentially files a ~$3B Hong Kong IPO, the first big China LLM-lab listing test. Meta's Muse Spark 1.3 makes its price play at $0.55/task, still trailing Claude Fable 5.1. Hugging Face ships a cheap 100-step GRPO recipe for structured outputs and funes, durable cross-agent memory; Teknium's recursive subagent swarm shed 375,000 lines from Hermes Agent in one 15-hour run.

articles.title: Anthropic ramps up Claude infrastructure with $35 billion Lambda deal
articles.summary: ~$35B Nvidia-backed Lambda deal adds ~350MW at Hut 8's Texas campus; ~$80B compute committed in days ahead of a reported fall IPO push.

articles.title: Chinese AI firm Moonshot files confidentially for Hong Kong IPO
articles.summary: Kimi maker targets ~$3B raise at ~$50B valuation after unwinding its red-chip structure — first big China LLM-lab public-listing test.

articles.title: Meta closes in on the top with Muse Spark 1.3, and undercuts rivals on price
articles.summary: Meta's fourth Muse model in five months: tops agentic gains but trails Claude Fable 5.1 — at $0.55/task it undercuts rivals; open weights promised.

articles.title: Fine-tuning a 350M Model for Better Structured Outputs in 100 GRPO Steps
articles.summary: Public TRL recipe: ~500 samples and 100 GRPO steps lift LiquidAI LFM2.5-350M from 22.6% to 29.7% on IFStruct schema compliance — sized for a free-tier GPU.

articles.title: Give Your Coding Agents a Memory You Own
articles.summary: HF's funes indexes Claude Code/Codex/pi session logs into one local vector store any agent can recall from — shareable across machines via HF datasets.

articles.title: Teknium: 1,320-subagent run deleted 375k lines from Hermes Agent
articles.summary: One /goal, ~15h, waves of ~120 recursive subagents on a single desktop shed 375,000 lines from the Hermes Agent repo — orchestration, not GPUs, is the ceiling.

articles.title: Qwen-3.8-Next-Flash Ngram hot-swappable knowledge injector for llama.cpp
articles.summary: llama.cpp mod patches the Qwen Ngram PLE table in-memory, turning it into a hot-swappable long-term knowledge store — with known limitations.
